title: Senior Software Engineer, remote
description:
Headquarters: Austin, TX

URL: https://edfinity.com 

About Edfinity 

Edfinity is the category leader in courseware and assessment technology for higher-ed STEM. We're NSF-supported, bootstrapped, and built by a close-knit remote team of senior engineers. We're growing fast and leading the field in AI-powered courseware that moves the needle on educator productivity and student outcomes. Your work will reach hundreds of institutions, and you will help decide how it gets built.

How we work 

- We're fully remote, with team members distributed across the US, and with that comes personal flexibility and accountability.

- AI agents produce most of our code. We move fast, but we temper velocity with quality and stability above all else.

- Engineers frame the problems, direct the work, and are accountable for everything that ships. If you already work this way and have opinions about it, you'll feel at home.

- Everyone has opportunities to work across different areas of the platform, and team members are expected to develop deep technical expertise over time. This is particularly important as we step away from hands-on coding.

- We're a small team of collaborative senior engineers. Your opinion matters.

- The pace of change is real. More than ever, we're continually evolving our tooling and workflows as LLMs become more capable.

What you’ll be doing 

Our stack is Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Elasticearch, ClickHouse, Redis/Sidekiq, and React.

- Full-stack product development in areas like assessment authoring, delivery, and grading; educator and student-facing features; LMS integrations

- LLM-powered features, from prompt architecture to auto-grading to eval infrastructure

- Performance optimization and reliability refactoring to handle both day-to-day load and high-stakes spikes

- Stewardship of a mature codebase: upgrades, migrations, and paying down technical debt methodically

- Part-time technical support rotation. Customer happiness is extremely important to us.

What you'll need 

- 8-15 years building and running scalable production web applications and services

- Deep experience with Rails

- Experience with web front-ends such as React

- Recent experience in an SDLC revolving around the use of AI agents

- Strong CS fundamentals in systems, data modeling, and complexity

- Excellent communication hygiene, collaborative skills, and strong sense of self-direction.

- Interest in a long-term seat on a close-knit team.

- Authorization to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor or transfer work visas at this time.

Compensation 

$135,000-$195,000, plus eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus, retirement plan, and PTO

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/edfinity-senior-software-engineer-remote

description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we are building the world's first clinical trial platform to create greater visibility, access, and engagement across a more diverse population of doctors and their patients.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor: we enable global pharmaceutical companies to confidently partner with community-based researchers to increase patient access to the latest medical innovations. Our AI-powered platform currently offers clinical trials from leading companies to over 5,500 sites across the globe and we are well poised for growth in 2026.

We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is the recent recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025.

The Role

We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to join our engineering team and build our product. You will report to an engineering manager and work in a diverse team composed of a product lead, AI engineers, and other software engineers.

You will be fully responsible for the development of new features in the product, guided by the product team’s focus on business impact. You will do this while maintaining the health of our codebase so that we can keep improving the product as fast as possible.

How is this opportunity different? 

- you will work on a product already used in production but still early in its life

- you will work hand-in-hand with a product team that cares more about business impact than the number of features delivered

- you will join an engineering team of 15 engineers with a strong culture of quality and continuous improvement

Typical projects you could be working on: 

- an integration of a service used by sites to manage their patients (called EHR) so that we can assess them against a trial.

- build a central experience for site networks that own several sites and allow them to bulk apply to trials and assess patients across their sites.

Salary range: 45k€ - 65k€, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

- Build features from beginning to end (design, implementation, deployment, support)

- Continuously work on improving the team processes and tools

- Share what you learn internally (ex: talk) and externally (ex: blog post)

Qualifications

- You can communicate clearly in both written and oral form in English and French

- As a full-stack software engineer, you have built and maintained a web product, in a team, in a fast-paced environment for 2 years or more.

- You have experience being proactive in your collaboration with product managers and designers, and want to leverage domain-driven design to make it effective.

- You are proficient with Typescript, React, and Next.JS

Bonus

- You have experience with functional programming, and want to use it in your job

- You worked in the healthcare industry

- You have experience in a startup/scaleup with a SaaS product

- You have faced the challenge of collaborating for several months on a shared codebase, and applied software craftsmanship techniques (TDD, clean code) to increase both pace and quality.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

Benefits

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About Dashlane 

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane , including how we work , how we hire , and the benefits of being a Dashlaner .

About the role: 

At Dashlane, we believe that data is an engine of growth and the voice of our customer. We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our collaborative and impact-driven Data & Analytics team. You will act as a senior strategic partner to the business, bridging the gap between deep technical modeling and business strategy to power how Dashlane makes decisions.

You will be a key driver in transforming our team from a reactive support function into a proactive, strategic powerhouse. Your work will directly shape how Dashlane measures success, from building out robust, AI-ready data foundations to delivering actionable insights that directly impact our bottom line. You will tackle complex data architecture problems, empower the organisation through self-service, and act as a force multiplier by mentoring peers and upskilling stakeholders.

If you are passionate about treating data as a product, succeed in autonomy, and want to have a massive, visible impact on a thriving B2B/B2C SaaS business, this role is for you.

Location-Specific Information: 

You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work. 

At Dashlane, you will: 

- Build & own complex data models: Design, build, test, and own end-to-end data models within our dbt-powered “Unified Data Model”. You will untangle historically messy datasets (like Salesforce) and refactor them into clean, intuitive models that serve as a single source of truth.

- Drive proactive business impact: Act as a consultative partner to our Product + Go-to-Market and business teams. Move beyond reactive "support desk" requests to uncover underlying business problems and deliver proactive, data-driven insights that drive measurable outcomes (shifting the conversation from "what happened" to "what's next").

- Champion self-service & upskill stakeholders: Be a primary driver of our self-service analytics culture. You will guide stakeholders toward scalable, self-serve solutions in Omni, gently pushing back on ad-hoc dashboard requests to upskill the organisation and scale autonomy.

- Pioneer AI data agents & automation: Implement AI data agents and the necessary underlying foundations to automate reporting and alerting for key business metrics, bringing an AI-first mindset to maximise the team's efficiency.

- Elevate data governance & the team: Implement and maintain data quality tests and governance best practices to ensure trust in our data. As a senior technical contributor, you will mentor more junior engineers, proactively improve team processes, and help raise the technical bar.

Requirements: 

- You have 5+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineering position or equivalent role.

- You are an expert in SQL and dbt, with deep, hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining complex data models in a production environment.

- You have strong strategic business acumen and a deep understanding of the B2B SaaS engine. You speak the language of ARR, NRR, churn, and product-led growth.

- You possess highly consultative stakeholder management skills. You don't just take tickets; you uncover the true business need, drive alignment, and take proactive ownership of initiatives from end to end.

- You are an "AI Champion." You are fluent with AI coding platforms such as Claude Code and you already have demonstrated experience integrating modern GenAI tooling into your day-to-day analytics workflow to accelerate development, and you are eager to mentor the rest of the organisation on these tools.

- You thrive in an autonomous, high-exposure environment and have a relentless curiosity to untangle complex data puzzles.

- You are fluent in English: verbal and written.

Our Tech Stack: 

- Data Modeling & Transformation: dbt

- Programming Languages: SQL, Python

- Data Platform: AWS (Redshift, S3, Lambda, Kinesis, Glue)

- BI & Visualisation: Omni

- Orchestration: Airflow

- CI/CD & Version Control: GitLab

- AI: Claude Code

What Dashlane offers you: 

- Equal Parental leave - regardless of gender, up to 20 weeks fully paid leave to take care of their new baby, within the first year of birth or adoption

- Health insurance is covered by Dashlane

- Mentorship program - select your mentor from our internal pool and continue your learning path!

- Meal Vouchers (Swile)

- 4 extra days off (one per quarter) to acknowledge the importance of your wellbeing

- Spot in daycare

- Time off saving account

- Donation matching program - give back to the community and support actions that lead to positive social impact under the historically marginalized communities. Every donation will be matched by Dashlane

- Team buildings & seasonal social events

- Weekly lunch in the office and monthly happy hour

- and many more!

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging at Dashlane: 

As a truly international company—founded in France and distributed across France, US and Portugal—Dashlane thrives off diverse perspectives. We value all aspects of diversity: gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, ethnic origin, social background, age, lifestyle, and more. We are committed to hiring a diverse community and fostering a culture where everyone is heard and belongs. See more about this here . 

Your interview experience:

That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

- Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

- Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace 

- Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do 

NetDocuments is seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent DMS to provide technical leadership across the next generation of our document management platform. This role will help shape the architecture connecting our new web and mobile experiences, design system, extended applications, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive platform. You’ll operate as a deeply hands-on technical leader, spending the majority of your time solving complex engineering problems while driving architectural decisions that span multiple teams and products. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, platform engineering, and our AI teams to establish scalable patterns, simplify complex systems, and ensure the experiences we build meet the reliability, security, performance, and usability standards expected by the world’s leading legal organizations.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Provide technical leadership across the Intelligent DMS organization, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards that span multiple teams and product surfaces.

- Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend services, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered experiences.

- Define shared technical patterns, component contracts, data models, permission models, and integration approaches that create a cohesive platform.

- Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from early product ideation through architecture, implementation, and production.

- Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, security, performance, usability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

- Simplify complex systems and establish technical foundations that enable teams to move faster as the platform evolves.

Design & Build

- Contribute directly to the most complex and consequential areas of the Intelligent DMS platform.

- Design and build cloud-native applications, microservices, integrations, and customer-facing experiences at enterprise scale.

- Help architect the next-generation web and mobile applications and the backend services that support them.

- Establish patterns for integrating AI capabilities such as assistants, summarization, extraction, and intelligent search into everyday document workflows.

- Lead technical design for Microsoft 365 experiences, including co-authoring and integrations across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- Design solutions that maintain correctness, security, and matter-levl permissions across highly concurrent and distributed workflows.

Platform Evolution & Modernization

- Define technical strategies for evolving mature applications and integrations onto the next-generation platform without disrupting critical customer workflows.

- Establish migration patterns that allow legacy and next-generation experiences to operate effectively during platform transitions.

- Drive technical coherence across extended applications, desktop clients, sync, import, browser extensions, mobile applications, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

- Partner with platform and AI engineering teams to establish scalable integration patterns for shared services and capabilities.

- Set performance and reliability standards for customer-facing applications and drive systemic improvements required to meet them.

Cross-Team Technical Leadership

- Lead technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams without relying on formal reporting authority.

- Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and AI teams around architectural direction and implementation strategy.

- Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical requirements, architecture, and executable plans.

- Document architectural decisions and ensure teams understand the reasoning, trade-offs, and standards behind them.

- Serve as a technical escalation point when teams encounter complex architectural or engineering challenges.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, including Senior and Staff Engineers, and provide guidance on architecture, system design, and engineering practices.

- Drive testing, quality, security, and reliability strategies across the Intelligent DMS organization.

- Establish and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, and technical patterns that scale beyond individual projects.

- Lead design and code reviews for complex or high-impact initiatives.

- Partner with other Principal Engineers and our Chief Architect to advance technical excellence across the broader engineering organization.

- Support recruiting and interviewing efforts to help build a high-performing engineering team.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

- Stay current with advancements in AI-native product development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and modern software engineering.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve customer experience or engineering effectiveness.

- Validate new technical approaches with real users and production feedback before scaling them broadly.

- Champion engineering practices that prioritize simplicity, measurable customer value, and sustainable technical foundations.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience operating at the Staff level or above.

- Proven experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams.

- Experience leading complex, cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority and driving alignment across engineering stakeholders.

- Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud applications, microservices, and enterprise-scale integrations.

- Strong full stack engineering experience with the ability to work across frontend and backend systems; our technology stack includes C#, .NET, React, and TypeScript.

- Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud technologies.

- Experience translating ambiguous product requirements into clear technical architecture and implementation plans.

- Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical guidance across teams.

- Strong technical writing skills with experience creating architecture documents, design proposals, and technical decision records.

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Experience shipping AI-native product experiences where AI is fundamental to the product workflow.

- Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office add-ins, Microsoft Graph, or co-authoring technologies.

- Experience modernizing legacy applications while maintaining heavily used production systems and managing complex customer migrations.

- Experience in legal technology, professional-services SaaS, or other regulated enterprise software environments.

- Public examples of technical leadership through conference speaking, technical writing, open-source contributions, or architectural patterns adopted by other teams.

- A track record of leading complex technical initiatives through both successful outcomes and lessons learned from approaches that did not work.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

- Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year)

- 10 paid holidays

- Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders

Compensation Transparency 

The compensation range for this position is $200,000 – $220,000.

The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

Equal Opportunity 

NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. NetDocuments believes diversity and inclusion among our employees is critical to our success, and we are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
Who is Tenable? 

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work? 

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role: 

The Security Consultant plays a key role in implementing and enabling Tenable’s Exposure Management solutions to help organizations effectively manage and reduce cyber risks. This role onboards Tenable technologies, following industry standards and best practices, to deliver customized solutions that address vulnerabilities across a client’s attack surface. This role's primary focus will be on client billable work, where you will ensure the efficient identification and mitigation of vulnerabilities. Additionally, the role will have the chance to broaden your knowledge across the Tenable portfolio through hands-on experience and learning opportunities facilitated by the Professional Services Organization.

Organisation Structure: 

- Reports to: Professional Services Delivery Manager/ Director
- Direct reports: None
Security Consultant Accountabilities: 

Client Engagement & Relationship Management: 

- Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business and unique security needs to deliver tailored engagements that exceed expectations.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and partnership.
- Provide clients with continual insights and consultative advice based on experience with Tenable products, their industry, established standards, and best practices.
Subject Matter Expertise and Solution Implementation & Enablement: 

- Support clients with the installation, configuration, and operation of Tenable solutions, ensuring they are effectively implemented to meet business and security goals.
- Oversee upgrades and migrations to new hardware or software, facilitating smooth transitions with minimal disruption.
- Offer expert guidance on implementing best practices with Tenable solutions to optimize security workflows and operational efficiency.
- Assist clients in developing and maintaining security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they align with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
- Provide ongoing value through insights and consultative advice on Tenable products, tailored to client needs and industry best practices.
- Share thought leadership on effective deployment and utilization of Tenable One solutions.
- Guide clients in implementing best practices and developing Exposure Management Programs.
- Assess user needs and customer requirements to advance the maturity of their Exposure Management program.
Value Delivery and Best Practices: 

- Deliver additional value through continual insights and consultative advice based on Tenable products, client needs, industry standards, and best practices.
- Provide thought leadership on methods and best practices for deploying and using Tenable One solutions.
- Advise clients on process best practices and assist in developing Exposure Management Programs.
- Research user needs and assess customer requirements to enhance the maturity of their Exposure Management program.
Customer Engagement and Satisfaction: 

- Ensure overall customer satisfaction while supporting delivery revenue objectives.
- Execute large customer engagements, understanding client business and unique needs to exceed expectations.
- Independently manage client escalations on assigned projects, coordinating with the delivery team and other Tenable departments as needed.
- Develop and maintain positive client relationships and train client staff on the implementation, configuration, and best practices of the Tenable suite.
Additional Responsibilities: 

- Perform other duties as assigned to support the success of the Professional Services team and the overall organization.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience: 

- 5+ years of experience in the Information Technology/Cyber Security field and professional services experience.
- Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English + another Language preferably Italian, Dutch or French. Must be comfortable leading 3+ hour calls and keeping up the progression of tasks on the call while assuring that all relevant topics are addressed.
- Strong analytical skills and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex security issues.
- Proficiency in assessing and identifying threats and risks related to Exposure Management, including vulnerabilities and weaknesses in host or network configurations.
- Recent experience performing vulnerability scans, configuration audits, and security monitoring with core Tenable products, or other industry solutions.
- Familiarity with Metasploit and related tools commonly used to exploit vulnerabilities.
- Familiarity with application security testing, OWASP and common exploitable web application threats in Exposure Management.
- Knowledge of auditing and configuration frameworks such as ISO 17799, CIS, PCI, GLBA, and HIPAA is preferred.
- Proven experience managing client expectations, building relationships and delivering consultative advice to ensure successful outcomes.
- Understanding of IT security principles associated with networks, operating systems, firewalls, databases, cloud infrastructure, identity and access management with experience in one or more of the fields.
- Familiar with developing integrations via REST API using known coding languages such as Python.
- Knowledge and understanding of SCADA and OT systems is a plus.
- Industry-recognised technical certifications preferred.
Working Environment and Conditions: 

- Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner.
- Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
- Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations and meetings.
- Client-facing travel may be required.
- Some Client site & Tenable office travel may be required.

title: Join Tech & Data
description:
Wir bauen den modernsten Schraubenhändler für den deutschen Mittelstand. Keine passende Stelle dabei? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Die Rolle schneiden wir um dich.

Was uns anders macht

Unsere Branche bestellt Spezialteile noch per Fax, E-Mail und Excel-Liste. Wir handeln selbst und bauen die Software dafür selbst: von der Anfrage bis zur Lieferung, auf Basis des GSF DataHub und mit AI-nativen Workflows. Wer jetzt dazukommt, ist früh genug dran, um zu prägen, wie alles funktioniert, und spät genug, dass es echte Kunden und echte Daten gibt.

Aufgaben

Daten & DataHub 

- Den GSF DataHub weiterentwickeln, unsere zentrale Datenplattform auf PostgreSQL, BigQuery und firestore

- Pipelines in Python bauen, Datenmodelle testen und dokumentieren

Integration & Automatisierung 

- ERP, CRM und Lieferanten per API anbinden

- Prozesse automatisieren: event-driven als Standard, n8n für schnelle MVPs

AI & LLM 

- LLMs in echte Prozesse bringen, etwa für Dokumentenextraktion, Routing und Klassifikation

- RAG-Workflows bauen, die dank Guardrails und Fallbacks auch produktiv funktionieren

Plattform & Tools 

- CI/CD mit GitHub Actions und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform auf GCP betreiben

- Interne Tools bauen, die Vertrieb und Einkauf gerne nutzen

Unser Stack 

Python · SQL · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · dbt · React · TypeScript · Google Cloud · Terraform · GitHub Actions · n8n · Claude Code

Qualifikation

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

- du sicher in Python und SQL bist und schon etwas gebaut hast, über das du gern erzählst, inklusive dem, was nicht funktioniert hat.

- du in Systemen denkst: Woher kommen die Daten, und was passiert, wenn ein Job um 3 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt?

- du MVP vor Perfektion stellst, aber weißt, wo diese Regel aufhört.

- du AI-Tools nicht nur nutzt, sondern an deinem Setup tüftelst und eine Meinung dazu hast, was funktioniert.

- du ein Problem lieber selbst in die Hand nimmst, als auf Anweisungen zu warten.

Pluspunkte sind Erfahrung mit dbt, GCP, Terraform, n8n oder RAG und Branchenwissen im B2B-Handel. Ob Berufseinstieg oder Senior: Uns interessiert, was du gebaut hast.

Benefits

- Stack-Ownership: Du gestaltest unsere Daten- und Integrations-Architektur aktiv mit. Vom API-Layer bis LLM-Workflow.

- AI-native by default: Cursor, Claude Code & Co. sind bei uns Werkzeug, nicht Diskussion. Wer Bock hat, prägt Best Practices fürs ganze Team.

- Starkes Umfeld: Du arbeitest direkt mit Technical Lead, Data und Automation Engineers zusammen für kurze Wege, echtes Feedback, schnelle Iteration.

- Spannende und herausfordernde Arbeit mit echtem Impact und Wachstum

- Transparente Vergütung – wir kommunizieren unser Vergütungsmodell klar und offen

- Regelmäßige Team-Events und Off-Sites

- Inspirierende Arbeitsumgebung: modernes, hochwertiges Office in Bielefeld mit top Anbindung

- Nah am Startup-Ökosystem in Berlin und OWL

So bewirbst du dich 

Schick uns deinen CV, ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen drei Fragen in je einem Satz:

Warum du? Warum jetzt? Warum das hier? 

So geht es weiter:

- schnelle Rückmeldung

- 30-minütiger Video-Call mit den Gründern Kevin und Niklas

- Kennenlerntag mit dem Team in Bielefeld

Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung vergehen 2–3 Wochen.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Marketing
description:
About 9fin 

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

What you’ll work on

You'll be embedded with our marketing team, turning campaign, web and funnel data into the decisions that drive demand and pipeline. Sitting within the analytics team alongside our analysts and analytics engineers, you'll own marketing analytics end-to-end, from instrumentation through to the insight that shapes where we spend.

- Own the inbound funnel metrics end-to-end. Define and own the metrics across landing → MQL → SQL → trial → conversion, so marketing, sales and leadership trust the same numbers.

- Build multi-touch attribution. Move beyond last-touch UTM tracking to attribution that shows which channels and campaigns actually drive pipeline and revenue.

- Measure channel and campaign performance. Show where we're winning across email, paid media, social, events and SEO — what to scale, and what to stop.

- Connect marketing to revenue. Model CAC, conversion, payback and cohort LTV, and quantify marketing's contribution to pipeline and bookings, in partnership with our GTM/RevOps analytics.

- Own marketing data models and the semantic layer. Author dbt models on BigQuery integrating HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics and Amplitude, and own the Omni semantic layer so the team gets self-serve answers as we migrate off Metabase.

- Own instrumentation and lead-data quality. Design landing-page and web tracking (UTMs, Amplitude), support lead-scoring models, and keep marketing and sales numbers aligned, trustworthy and GDPR-compliant.

- Own web and SEO analytics. Track website traffic, SEO performance and inbound lead quality, and turn it into clear recommendations.

- Be the embedded analytical partner to marketing. Work directly with demand gen and RevOps, translating campaign questions into analysis that drives spend and prioritisation decisions.

About You

You're a senior, hands-on individual contributor with real technical depth who thrives on turning marketing and funnel data into decisions that move pipeline and revenue.

- Proven analytics experience supporting marketing, growth, demand gen or RevOps, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.

- Expert SQL for complex analysis , optimisation and reusable datasets.

- dbt & a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or similar) — commercial experience building production models, tests and docs.

- Modern BI with an integrated semantic layer — building self-serve dashboards and owning metric definitions (e.g. Omni, Looker, Thoughtspot).

- Deep knowledge of the marketing stack — HubSpot (or similar automation/CRM), Salesforce, Google Analytics and digital/web/event analytics.

- Attribution and funnel expertise — multi-touch attribution, CAC, conversion and LTV/payback, with the statistical judgement to separate signal from noise.

- A strong communicator who turns analysis into clear narratives marketing and leadership can act on.

- Strategic problem solver who owns metric definitions and builds validation so numbers are trusted across teams.

- Bonus: Python for deeper analysis; experience with paid-media analytics, SEO or marketing experimentation.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance 

- Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

- Equity options

- Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

- Private Medical Insurance

- Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

- Group Life Assurance

- Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off 

- 25 holiday days per year

- Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

- Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

- Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

- 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

- Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture 

- Professional learning and development budget

- Quarterly team socials

- Summer and Winter company social events

9fin is an equal opportunities employer 

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Solutions Architect - MENA
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is investing in Arabic-language capabilities, and the customers who are building on them deserve a technical partner who speaks the language and knows the region firsthand. We are hiring an Applied Engineer to be that partner: the first member of our Applied Engineering team who is dedicated to Arabic-speaking markets. We would love for you to be based in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), and the search is open across the broader EMEA region.

You'll operate in the Solutions Architect role, leading the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover. Because you'll be the first dedicated technical presence in the region, you'll also take a strong share of pre-sales work, including the technical discovery, proof-of-concepts, and evaluations that earn the technical win for regional prospects. You'll represent Deepgram in front of customers and at regional events, and you'll bring what you learn back to our Product and Research teams, including how our Arabic models perform across dialects in production.

The region's time zones overlap fully with EMEA business hours, so you'll work alongside our EMEA Applied Engineers every day, and you'll help to extend coverage toward APAC hours as the team grows.

About the Solutions Architect Role at Deepgram

Solutions Architects at Deepgram own the periods when a customer's environment is changing (a new onboarding, a scaling deployment, a migration, a feature rollout). The work is hands-on and technical. You'll design solutions that fit each customer's stack and constraints, drive the deployment work itself, and turn what each engagement teaches you into reusable patterns that compress how long it takes the next customer to reach value. In this seat, the motion extends into pre-sales. For many regional prospects, you'll be the first Deepgram engineer that they meet, and the same skills that make implementations succeed (listening well, designing to constraints, showing working software) also win evaluations.

You'll be hired into the Applied Engineer position on our Applied Engineering team, which combines what other companies split into Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, Forward-Deployed Engineering, and Technical Support, with a single growth ladder from Associate through Principal. The region is your focus; Applied Engineering is where you grow.

What You'll Do

- Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations across MENA, from kickoff through production cutover

- Lead technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, and evaluations for regional prospects, partnering with Account Executives through the sales cycle

- Design solutions that fit each customer's stack, constraints, and data-residency requirements

- Represent Deepgram in front of Arabic-speaking customers and at regional events

- Bring the voice of Arabic-language customers to our Product and Research teams, including feedback on Arabic model performance across dialects

- Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader team and customers can reuse

- Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases in the region, and help to grow our coverage into APAC hours over time

Time Allocation

- 40% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

- 25% — Pre-sales technical work, including discovery, demos, proof-of-concepts, and evaluations

- 15% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

- 10% — Documentation, knowledge sharing, and product feedback

- 10% — Complex post-onboarding escalations for regional customers

Your First 90 Days

- First 30 Days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and competitive landscape. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements and discovery calls across EMEA accounts to learn how the Applied Engineering team operates.

- 60 Days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end to end, and lead technical discovery for regional prospects alongside Account Executives. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns, and deliver your first Arabic-focused demo or evaluation asset.

- 90 Days — Own the technical relationship with your assigned regional accounts. Run evaluations and implementations concurrently, and establish a working feedback loop with our Product and Research teams on Arabic model performance.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane , including how we work , how we hire , and the benefits of being a Dashlaner .

About the role: 

At Dashlane, we believe that data is an engine of growth and the voice of our customer. We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our collaborative and impact-driven Data & Analytics team. You will act as a strategic partner to the business, bridging the gap between deep technical modeling and business strategy to power how Dashlane makes decisions.

You will be a key driver in transforming our team from a reactive support function into a proactive, strategic powerhouse. Your work will directly shape how Dashlane measures success, from building out robust, AI-ready data foundations to delivering actionable insights that directly impact our bottom line. You will tackle complex data architecture problems, empower the organisation through self-service, and act as a force multiplier by mentoring peers and upskilling stakeholders.

If you are passionate about treating data as a product, succeed in autonomy, and want to have a massive, visible impact on a thriving B2B/B2C SaaS business, this role is for you.

Location-Specific Information: 

You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. - Pioneer AI data agents & automation: Implement AI data agents and the necessary underlying foundations to automate reporting and alerting for key business metrics, bringing an AI-first mindset to maximise the team's efficiency.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description:
Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world. 

Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight.

For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work.

More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers.

We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims.

This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on.

If you want unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform , Matomo is worth a serious look.

Why this role matters 

Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features. 

It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. 

We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. 

As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. 

You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. 

What you’ll own 

You'll own problems, not just code. 

This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. 

You'll own work from problem to outcome: 

- 
Understand the problem before committing to a solution. 

- 
Help shape priorities, not just implement them. 

- 
Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you. 

- 
Ship incrementally and learn from real usage. 

- 
Measure outcomes and iterate. 

- 
Use AI throughout your workflow. 

For senior: You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. 

For intermediate: You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs. 

What the work looks like 

You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. 

Examples include: 

- 
Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase. 

- 
Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo. 

- 
Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on. 

- 
Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases. 

- 
Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations. 

- 
Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. 

- 
Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring. 

- 
Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards.

- 
Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use. 

- 
Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. 

How we work 

We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size.

That means we optimise for impact.

We value:

- 
Customer problems over technical elegance.

- 
Shipping over endless planning.

- 
Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.

- 
Ownership over handoffs.

- 
Iteration over perfection.

- 
Clear writing over excessive meetings.

- 
Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture.

- 
AI where it helps us move faster.

- 
Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right.

We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it.

At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary.

What we’re looking for 

For senior: You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. 

For intermediate: You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. 

You enjoy building products 

You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone.

You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses.

You naturally ask:

- 
What problem are we solving?

- 
Who has this problem?

- 
Is this the simplest useful solution?

- 
How will we know this made things better?

- 
What should we do if the data shows we were wrong?

You are comfortable with complex, mature systems 

You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository.

You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites.

You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified.

You are comfortable across the stack

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Zurich, Switzerland
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity. 

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview 

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. What Yo u’ ll Do

description:

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us and make mental healthcare more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the role: 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale 

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

- Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

- Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

- Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

- Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

- Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring: 

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product 

- 5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

- Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

- Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

- Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

- The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

Nice-to-haves: 

- Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

- Open-source contribution experience.

- Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

- Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

title: Software Engineer - Internal Tools
description:

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us 

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

- Ownership
We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

Internal tooling is not a backlog item at Prelude — it's a strategic lever. As we scale from 50 to a much larger team, the speed at which engineering, ops, sales, support, and finance can operate depends on the tools we put in their hands.

You'll own that surface. title: Platform Product Engineer
description:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco .

About the Job: 

Under the direction of the Director of Engineering, the Platform Product Engineer acts as a high-leverage technical leader bridging robust platform architecture and product-centric AI innovation. This role handles high-stakes ambiguity and complexity, balancing scalable infrastructure and platform foundation work with the direct delivery of user-facing AI product features. The Platform Product Engineer collaborates closely with Product, Architecture, and Platform leads to convert complex business requirements into high-integrity technical plans, advancing Zone’s product vision by engineering reliable AI features and agentic workflows embedded within a scalable, production-grade platform.

Essential Job Functions 

- Architect and deliver complex, high-value platform systems and customer-facing AI product features across the Zone platform, ensuring high performance, observability, and scalability.

- Balance core platform engineering responsibilities with product engineering priorities, translating business and user needs into seamless technical execution.

- Design and maintain foundational platform infrastructure to empower product teams to build, test, and ship AI-native capabilities rapidly and safely.

- Drive the engineering of automated validation frameworks to verify AI-generated features and core business logic against strict financial standards.

- Anticipate architectural pressure points and resolve bottlenecks before they impact roadmap delivery.

- Champion the use of modern coding tools, agentic SDLC, and product-focused AI workflows to maximize engineering velocity and product quality.

- Stay current with emerging AI technologies and research, recommending innovative approaches

- Manage time effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables

- Exemplify Zone & Co ’s culture, providing exceptional service and aligning with company values at all times

Responsibilities / Duties / Tasks 

- Architect, deploy, and support production-grade platform infrastructure and AI product features, including agentic workflows and interactive user experiences.

- Decompose vague software requirements into staged execution plans that mitigate risk and enhance delivery predictability.

- Establish and maintain robust automated validation and verification discipline for AI models and business logic.

- Proactively refactor fragile path areas and maintain exemplary code quality in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and associated AI frameworks.

- Translate technical debt and architectural tradeoffs into clear business consequences for engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Integrate AI/ML models with existing backend and frontend systems

- Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through rigorous design guidance, thorough code reviews, and the promotion of AI-native best practices.

- Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers

- Contribute to the evaluation and adoption of new infrastructure or cloud services for AI workloads

- Manage and optimize AWS services including ECS, Lambda, Postgres, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and Amplify for scalable AI and platform infrastructure

- Communicate outcomes, technical details, and challenges to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Maintain a strong commitment to data quality, privacy, and ethical AI development

- Engage in ongoing learning and professional development aligned with Zone & Co’s strategic objectives

Job Qualifications / Skill Requirements 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in the Fintech domain, with a strong focus on platform development, ERP integrations, or SaaS applications.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.

- Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate development and design robust AI features.

- Strong programming proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript with proven experience handling complex backend architecture.

- Strong database skills, both relational (i.e. SQL) and non-relational storage

- Proven ability to lead complex projects from ambiguity to successful production delivery in an asynchronous, globally distributed environment.

- Required hands-on expertise with AWS platform services (including ECS, Lambda, Postgres, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, and Amplify), cloud infrastructure management, and deployment pipelines for scalable AI workloads.

- Strong judgment in verification discipline and experience designing automated testing solutions for high-consequence business logic.

- Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in English

- Passion for innovation and creating value through technology

- Proficiency in AI-assisted coding, including building and maintaining custom skills and integrating with Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for tools like Jira.

- Nice-to-have: Familiarity with data science principles and hands-on experience with model tuning.

What to Expect During Your Technical Interview 
The technical interview focuses on high-level system design and real-world engineering challenges rather than traditional algorithm or syntax memorization exercises. Candidates will collaborate with interviewers on an interactive system design exercise, sketching out high-level architecture and discussing modern implementation approaches. Access to an AI coding assistant (such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) during the interview is recommended, as we value leveraging AI tools to solve complex system problems effectively.

Benefits 

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers 

Join Our Global Mission 

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities :

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

- Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS

- Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills

- Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.
